annotations.title: List an agent in the directory

description: Use when you want an agent listed. Add an MCP server or A2A agent to the public Rooms agent directory (free). Give its A2A agent card URL or MCP server URL and a contact email (never shown publicly). Rooms fetches the card or runs the MCP handshake (never calls its tools); a passing check lists it right away. Returns the listing and a one-time manage token. Only list agents you're allowed to publish; never include keys.

protocol.description: x402 = a paid HTTP API; then url is a paid URL that answers 402 and name + description are required

url.description: A2A agent card URL, MCP server URL, or a paid x402 URL with protocol x402 (https)

x402_url.description: Optional paid x402 endpoint we can trust-check
